1.w: A musical composition by David, which he sang to the Lord concerning a Benjaminite named Cush. O Lord my God, in you I have taken shelter. Deliver me from all who chase me. Rescue me!

2.w: Otherwise they will rip me to shreds like a lion; they will tear me to bits and no one will be able to rescue me.

3.w: O Lord my God, if I have done what they say, or am guilty of unjust actions,

4.w: or have wronged my ally, or helped his lawless enemy,

5.w: may an enemy relentlessly chase me and catch me; may he trample me to death and leave me lying dishonored in the dust. (Selah)

6.w: Stand up angrily, Lord. Rise up with raging fury against my enemies. Wake up for my sake, and execute the judgment you have decreed for them.

7.w: The countries are assembled all around you; take once more your rightful place over them.

8.w: The Lord judges the nations. Vindicate me, Lord, because I am innocent, because I am blameless, O Exalted One.

9.w: May the evil deeds of the wicked come to an end. But make the innocent secure, O righteous God, you who examine inner thoughts and motives.

10.w: The Exalted God is my shield, the one who delivers the morally upright.

11.w: God is a just judge; he is angry throughout the day.

12.w: If a person does not repent, God will wield his sword. He has prepared to shoot his bow.

13.w: He has prepared deadly weapons to use against him; he gets ready to shoot flaming arrows.

14.w: See the one who is pregnant with wickedness, who conceives destructive plans, and gives birth to harmful lies—

15.w: he digs a pit and then falls into the hole he has made.

16.w: He becomes the victim of his own destructive plans — and the violence he intended for others falls on his own head.

17.w: I will thank the Lord for his justice; I will sing praises to the Lord Most High!
